body:
# MineDrive

![MineDrive Icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d9cd704a02dd88d9f357cf728643c32960e30568.png)

MineDrive is a Minecraft cloud save mod powered by **Google Drive**, designed to sync and back up worlds, player data, and saves between devices.

## Features

- ☁️ Cloud synchronization for Minecraft saves
- 💾 Automatic backup support
- 🔄 Sync worlds and player data between multiple devices
- ⚡ Lightweight and easy to use
- 🧩 Built for the **Fabric** mod loader

## About the Project

MineDrive is a new project forked from **MineGIT** and is currently available only for the **Fabric** mod loader.

## [Original Mod (MineGIT)](https://modrinth.com/mod/minegit)

### Development Status

> The mod is still in early development, so features and stability may change over time.
